theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intro Hup Hinit
  have HL := UpdateStatesLength Hup
  have HL' := InitStatesLength Hinit
  have HD := UpdateStatesDefined' Hup
  have Hnd := UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' (InitStatesNotDefined Hinit) Hup
  refine ⟨_, rfl, updatedStatesInit HL' Hnd (InitStatesNodup Hinit), (show σ'' = updatedStates (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ks vs from by
    simp only [InitStatesUpdated Hinit, UpdateStatesUpdated Hup]
    apply updatedStatesComm
    simp only [List.unzip_zip HL, List.unzip_zip HL']
    exact fun _ hx hx' => by simpa [Hnd _ hx'] using HD _ hx) ▸ updatedStatesUpdate HL (updatedStatesDefMonotone HD)⟩
